About these 7 rides

The earliest start is Sun & Ski Sunday Shop Ride at 7:00 am; the latest is Coffee & Bikes Sunday Social Ride at 8:05 am. The group waits for everyone on 1 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. By bike: 5 road and 2 social. They run 5 every week, 1 once a month and 1 on dates posted one at a time. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Oct 19, 2026.
